notes.title: Autogun Heroes: Supercharged Now Out!
notes.content: [p][b]Today is finally the day! [i]Autogun Heroes: Supercharged[/i] is officially live, and we couldn’t have done it without YOU.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for your passion, for all your demo and playtesting feedback, and of course for your unrelenting support. Whether you've been with us since the original [i]Autogun Heroes[/i] adventure on mobile or you're just now joining the battle, this game is for you.[/p][p][/p][p]Working on a video game is an adventure all in itself, and it's always a nerve-wrecking experience to put something that we've been working hard on out into the world. We've spent a long time with Gus and preparing for this day. This game is no longer ours, it's yours, and we hope you enjoy it.[/p][p][/p][p]As we're a small developer, reviews and word of mouth mean a lot to us. If you check out the game, and you have a spare moment afterwards, we would really appreciate it if you could write a few words about your experience on Steam. It allows more players to find us, and for us to feed our pets.[/p][p][/p][p]As it's the launch day, we also wanted to do something a little special for our community. To celebrate, we are giving away a custom Autogun Heroes: Supercharged Xbox controller, designed by our in-house artist, Kia. Entering is incredibly simple, just follow the link here: [url="https://gleam.io/rLq4n/win-a-custom-autogun-heroes-supercharged-xbox-controller"]https://gleam.io/rLq4n/win-a-custom-autogun-heroes-supercharged-xbox-controller[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Giveaway Ends: June 24th 2025[/p][p]T&Cs: [url="https://www.nitrogames.com/contest-tcs/"]https://www.nitrogames.com/contest-tcs/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Autogun Heroes: Supercharged Launching June 18th
notes.content:
[p]We're excited to reveal that Autogun Heroes: Supercharged will be launching on Steam on June 18th! It's been a long time coming, and we really appreciate the wonderful players who have supported us. (That's you! Thank you!) We hope you love this game as much as we do. 

In Autogun Heroes: Supercharged, the player steps into the aged boots of Gus, the galaxy’s bravest and seasoned hero. When the Vorx kidnaps his crew and friends, Gus is tasked with their safe return, and to help the continuing war against the parasitic alien fleet. It’s not going to be easy, with advanced technology and complex attack patterns, Gus must be resourceful and use everything at his disposal if he’s going to survive.[/p][p]Inspired by the enduring passion for retro games, [i]Autogun Heroes: Supercharged[/i] is a return to our PC roots with a brand-new standalone adventure tailored specifically for the platform. The game presents a fast-paced bullethell challenge spanning across the stars. By carefully balancing intense combat with rewarding gameplay and tight, responsive controls, [i]Autogun Heroes: Supercharged[/i] delivers a package will resonate with fans and newcomers alike.

Press & Creator Email: rachel@nitrogames.fi[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342366/23b2a7627eae43330ce6d974f5fb3e6db8aa4c54.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Autogun Heroes: Supercharged Joins Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p][b]We’re excited to announce that Autogun Heroes: Supercharged is joining Steam Next Fest! We’ve been looking forward to this digital celebration for a long time, so we made sure to have some extra special events scheduled for this week. [/b][/p][p][b]Alongside our thrilling new demo, we also have a week of giveaways, developer Q&As, and teasers to share. Check out the list below of just some of the things we’re doing, and stay tuned for more events later this week![/b] 
  [/p][h3][b]Play the Demo![/b][/h3][p]For the digital event, we are rolling out a brand-new demo, a small snippet of the chaos you can expect in the full game. Inspired by the retro games we grew up loving, Autogun Heroes: Supercharged combines rewarding combat with slick arcade-inspired visuals, to create a thrilling and nostalgic concoction. What’s a better way to relax after a long day?

You play as Gus, the universe’s greatest (and most humble) hero. His goal? To save his crew and fight back against the parasitic infestation known as the Vorx. The journey will be packed with quick fire challenges and terrifying hordes that only the bravest can overcome. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342366/cd91e9f1cd24c9ccfd8731afbf4ca9bfa19105cc.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]T-Shirt Giveaway![/b][/h3][p]We’re celebrating Steam Next Fest with a special giveaway and rather handsome prize. Our wonderful in-house artist, Ronja, has designed a limited edition t-shirt for the occasion, featuring Gus and Raffa holding off the Vorx threat.  
[/p][p]Getting involved is incredibly easy; all you have to do is follow us on social media. Whether you’re a new follower or already part of our wonderful community, make sure to confirm your entries through [url="https://gleam.io/HjgBV/win-a-limited-edition-autogun-heroes-supercharged-tshirt"]https://gleam.io/HjgBV/win-a-limited-edition-autogun-heroes-supercharged-tshirt[/url] to be eligible.[/p][p]The winners will be selected at random to receive a voucher to claim their limited edition t-shirt with free shipping and the option to customise their order through the new Nitro Games Store.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342366/c2c591659357092ae7cea80df2681ee7ef0ff250.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Speed Run Tournament![/b][/h3][p]Have you got what it takes to be the universe’s greatest hero? Take on our new Speed Run challenge and show us your skills in a gruelling international tournament to find our legendary players. The task is simple, take on the first world and complete it in the quickest time possible. With a boss fight awaiting you, it's not as easy as it sounds![/p][p]The top five players with the fastest scores will unlock prizes ranging from t-shirts to digital games. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342366/df5043213a53b04126a9d3b0459a43e0e3c7f8b1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Thank you to all of our wonderful players! We hope you enjoy the demo. This game is for you.[/b] [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: DEMO IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Enjoy this sneak peak of Autogun Heroes: Supercharged, the game that truly is a love letter to retro games, and the players who keep the genre alive.

We promise you, beating the demo will not be easy! This game is meant to be challenging but still fun, just like those old retro games that made you almost give up, but you never did because you decided to play it until the end. Go rogue and never give up! Enjoy!

notes.title: Dodge. Roll. Dominate! Welcome to Autogun Heroes: Supercharged
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342366/2eb04c713209fa471dff03f632689d97bdedb2bf.png[/img]

The galaxy is under siege by alien invaders, and it’s up to you to take it back! Dive into Autogun Heroes: Supercharged, a thrilling 2D shoot-'em-up that blends skill-based platforming with tight, responsive controls. Assemble a team of unique heroes, optimize their abilities, and dominate your way through action-packed worlds. Dodge. Roll. Dominate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342366/9b27e65059759b7251536e48127ee7104771a383.png[/img]

[b]What to Expect:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Skill-Based Action:[/b] Experience fast-paced 2D platforming combined with responsive controls for precise and satisfying gameplay.
[*] [b]Diverse Hero Roster:[/b] Assemble your team from a wide variety of heroes, each with unique abilities. Find the hero that matches your playstyle and strategy.
[*] [b]Customizable Loadouts:[/b] Optimize your hero’s performance by equipping them with weapons, gadgets, and armor. Fine-tune their stats like damage, fire rate, and defense to match your playstyle.
[*] [b]Alien Infested Planets to Re-Conquer:[/b] Fight across vast game worlds, each crawling with enemies and challenges. It’s your job to reclaim the galaxy!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342366/86b4320a08790aecc9fef8ba3898a5ca50297f00.png[/img]

[b]Whether you’re blasting through alien hordes, perfecting your stats, or mastering skillful platforming, Autogun Heroes: Supercharged delivers an electrifying experience that will keep you on your toes.
The galaxy won’t save itself—are you ready to take the fight to the aliens?[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3328730/Autogun_Heroes_Supercharged/
